matching_principles: Infer the actual day-to-day work before scoring anything.
Ignore the advertised title until the work is understood.
career_fit measures the work; opportunity_score measures this vacancy.
Unknown is a state of its own; it is never evidence of failure.
Explicit mandatory language requirements are hard blockers.
A Swedish-language advertisement is not a Swedish-language requirement.
Background screening does not imply citizenship or clearance eligibility.
Seniority claims must rest on evidence, not on titles.
Prefer a false positive that costs a click over a false negative that hides a good role.
